# Third-party dependencies

This directory contains dependencies sourced outside UNIX768 and kept
separate from project-owned code:

- `musashi`: Motorola 68000 CPU core used by the Epoch68 emulator
- `miniaudio`: optional audio support used by Epoch68

Exact imported revisions, local modifications, notices, and license locations
are recorded in [`../THIRD_PARTY.md`](../THIRD_PARTY.md).
